subject: CAIQ phased submission & owner lanes — intake and next steps
messages:
From: Jared Mills <security@vantagehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: VantageHealth Audit Team <audit@vantagehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake and phased submission request

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this on — VantageHealth is preparing for a targeted CSA assessment next quarter and we'd like to collect the CAIQ responses and supporting evidence in a staged way so our audit board can sign off incrementally. Our ask: can Redwood provide a phased CAIQ submission (answers + evidence bundles) scoped to the controls relevant to our use of hosted inference (multi-tenant) vs private deployments?

Primary asks:
- High-level CAIQ answers for all applicable controls (we're ok with staged delivery).
- Evidence for top-priority controls (data residency, key management, tenant isolation, runtime telemetry) by July 8.
- Clarify any control variants you treat differently for dedicated vs private deployments (we have both in scope).

Attached is VantageHealth's intake PDF with control focus areas. Can you also point us to the owner lane (who owns which control families) and a secure upload for evidence?

Thanks,
Jared Mills
Head of Security
VantageHealth

Attachments: VA_CAIQ_Request_20270621.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Mills <security@vantagehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and phased submission request

Hi Jared — appreciate the clear ask and the intake doc. Short answer: yes, we can do a phased CAIQ submission and map control variants for hosted vs private. Outline below and next steps.

Plan (high level):
1) Phase 0 (by Jun 28): CAIQ answer set (plain-text responses) for all in-scope controls + control-variant annotation (multi-tenant vs dedicated/private).
2) Phase 1 (by Jul 8): Evidence bundle for priority controls you listed: data residency, KMS/HSM proof, tenant isolation architecture diagrams, and runtime telemetry samples (anonymized).
3) Phase 2 (by Jul 22): Remaining evidence artifacts and audit-friendly narrative per control.

Owner lanes (proposed):
- Identity & Keys: Priyom Das (applies to shared & private; will note where rotation differs).
- Runtime & Telemetry: Marissa Cole (will gather sanitized KV cache/telemetry samples).
- Architecture & Isolation: Neha Kapoor (I'll own the tenancy model narrative + diagrams).

We have a lightweight mapping template attached (caiq_phase0_answers_v1.xlsx) — I'll populate Phase 0 answers and send to you for review. For evidence upload: we can provide a limited-access Drive folder + DocuSign/evidence checklist. Which of the options do you prefer for ingestion (SFTP, Drive link with upload token, or your secure portal)?

Quick clarifying q: you mentioned both hosted inference and private deploys — do you want control responses to reflect both variants inline (preferred) or two separate CAIQ matrices? Either works, but inline variant annotations make it easier for auditors to see behavior differences.

Onboarding next steps: I'll send Phase 0 answers by Jun 28 and attach the control-variant matrix if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: caiq_phase0_answers_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Mills <security@vantagehealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake and phased submission request

Hi Jared / Neha — adding a few technical notes on how we'll treat control variants so we can pre-seed the Phase 0 answers.

1) Control variant approach:
- Where the control depends on deployment model we will provide a short "variant" column in the CAIQ answer ("Hosted: X", "Dedicated: Y", "Private: Z").
- Example: Key storage — Hosted: keys in Redwood-managed KMS (customer keys may be wrapped via customer KMS on request); Private: customer-managed KMS/HSM with rotation policy in customer's env.

2) Telemetry & evidence:
- Marissa will provide anonymized telemetry slices (tokenized IDs and sampling) for runtime observability controls. We will include a trace sample for a 5-minute production window (no PII, prompt contents redacted).

3) Evidence packaging:
- We'll attach architecture diagrams (PDF), signed attestation for tenant isolation (PDF), runtime telemetry CSV (sanitized), and a control_variant_matrix.csv mapping sub-controls to owners.

I've attached the initial control_variant_matrix.csv with owner columns populated for Phase 0. If VantageHealth wants a separate matrix for hosted vs private, we can generate that as Phase 1 deliverable, but my preference is inline variants to reduce duplication.

On the ingestion method: Drive link + upload token is easiest for our team to manage; if your procurement legal team requires SFTP, we can accommodate.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: control_variant_matrix.csv (csv)

Hi Jared — thanks, we confirmed the internal timeline and owners. Short update and logistics: 

1) Schedule:
- Phase 0 (CAIQ answers): deliverable posted to Drive by Jun 28.
- Phase 1 (priority evidence): upload window opens Jul 1 and we will push artifacts to the Drive folder by Jul 8.

2) Evidence ingestion: we've created a scoped Drive folder and a one-time upload token for VantageHealth intake. Link + instructions below. Please use the intake folder only for evidence; do not share publicly.
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzVantage/CAIQ-VantageHealth
- Upload token & instructions: see attached vantage_evidence-upload-instructions.pdf

3) Owners:
- Identity & Keys: Priyom Das — responsible for KMS attestations, rotation logs, and HSM configuration notes.
- Runtime Telemetry & Sampling: Marissa Cole — will include sanitized trace samples and telemetry schema.
- Isolation & Architecture: Neha Kapoor — tenancy architecture diagrams and isolation attestation.

4) Next actions for you: please confirm you accept Drive upload + token flow. Also confirm if you need separate CAIQ matrices per deployment model (we will default to inline variant annotations unless you ask otherwise).

Thanks, looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability & Evidence
Redwood Inference
